_note: PLACEHOLDERS, NOT YET SOURCED. Every value here must be replaced with a sourced South African figure (FEATURES.md F4) before the demo. Used only when the founder says 'I don't know' or a template needs a starting point; shown in the UI as 'assumed' or 'template' with a range.

caps._note: PLACEHOLDER caps for a small, owner-led business. A figure above its cap is questioned and the founder confirms it (F4); a value is never changed silently. All are per month except cash and upfrontCost.

setbacks._note: PLACEHOLDER sizes for the fixed setback library (SCOPE.md §3), applied as stress tests from defaultMonth. Late payment starts at the first contract payment when a path has one.

contract._paymentDays: Used when the founder does not say when the client pays. Safer terms ask for payment within saferPaymentDays.
contract._offerShareOfSales: Contract value as a share of today's monthly sales, used only when the founder does not give it.
contract._directShare: Direct costs of the contract work (food, stock, materials) as a share of its value.
contract._equipmentRentShare: Monthly rent for the same equipment, as a share of its price, while the contract runs.

hire._rampMonths: Months before a new person brings in extra sales.
hire._upliftMultiple: Extra gross profit the new person brings in, as a multiple of what they cost.

pricing._churn: Share of sales lost to customers who leave after the rise; smallChurn is for half the rise.
